label: DEEP-RESEARCH TASK: study COMPETITOR signage app libraries — Yodeck, ScreenCloud, Rise Vi

findings.summary:
Studied six signage app libraries (Yodeck, ScreenCloud, Rise Vision, Xibo, Play Digital Signage, NoviSign) plus OptiSigns. They all converge on the same pattern: a category-filtered grid of named "apps," each a thin wrapper over a generic primitive (iframe/RSS/API-poll/screenshot) with a polished per-app config form, plan-tier badge, and live preview pane. The hard truth for 2026 is that social embeds are broken: Instagram Basic Display API hit EOL Dec 2024, Meta oEmbed lost thumbnails/author Nov 2025, and X/Twitter read access is fully paid — Play Digital Signage flat-out DISCONTINUED its Twitter plugin. So every "Instagram/Facebook/TikTok/X" app you see is really one of: (a) Meta Graph API + a Business account, or (b) a paid third-party aggregator (Walls.io, Taggbox, EmbedSocial, Curator, Flockler). The single biggest leapfrog idea is ScreenCloud's "Dashboards": private Power BI/Tableau/Looker/Grafana rendered SERVER-SIDE as an encrypted screen-grab (credentials in AWS Secrets Manager, only a static image to the screen) — no public URL, and it conveniently dodges the Chromium-83 LED problem. VenueOS can ship ~80% of these apps today by wrapping existing widgets (WEBPAGE/RSS_FEED/SOCIAL_FEED/STREAMING/LIVE_DATA/CHART) in named, per-app config forms; the high-value net-new build is a server-side dashboard-screenshot service plus an AI-Concierge "paste your URL → we pick the app + fill the config" flow nobody else has.</summary>

<uxNotes>[
"Universal layout: a category-filtered GRID of app cards. OptiSigns tabs = All / Misc / News / Finance / Social Media / Photos & Video / File Management / Communication / Business. ScreenCloud groups = Bespoke Content Creation / Live Feeds / Content & Files / Social Displays / Internal Communication / External Communication / Business Intelligence. Adopt a similar, vertical-aware category set.",
"Each app card shows: logo, name, one-line description, category tag, and a PLAN-TIER badge ('Included in all plans' / 'Standard and up' / 'Pro Plus and up'). The tier badge does marketing work — it advertises premium apps to free users. VenueOS can map this to its BYOK/Concierge economic tiers.",
"Search box with graceful empty-state ('No matches found, try another search'). Pagination for 100+ apps (OptiSigns shows '1/10').",
"Per-app CONFIG FORM is the core UX: each app opens a tailored form (e.g. Google Slides = paste published link; Weather = location + units + variant; Power BI = login/connect). This is exactly VenueOS's wedge over 'paste a raw URL into WEBPAGE'.",
"LIVE PREVIEW pane: ScreenCloud shows a right-hand preview that updates as you paste/configure ('paste the public URL... you'll see a preview appear on the right-hand side'). A preview-as-you-type pane is table stakes — VenueOS already has preview infra to reuse.",
"App INSTANCES are reusable + shareable: ScreenCloud lets you save a configured app and SHARE it across Spaces/teams (hover card -> 3-dot -> Share, set permissions). Treat a configured app as a savable, brandable, reusable object — not a one-off.",
"NAMED-BRAND multiplication: Yodeck inflates its app count by shipping ~18 named news feeds (CNN/BBC/ESPN/...) that are all just RSS under the hood, and 6 clock variants. Cheap way to look like you have 140 apps while reusing 3 primitives. Marketing-effective + genuinely easier for operators (pick 'CNN', not 'find a feed URL').",
"DASHBOARDS are sold as a SEPARATE premium pillar, not just an app: ScreenCloud has a whole 'Dashboards' product (Power BI/Tableau/Grafana/Looker) gated to Pro/Enterprise, with security as the headline ('display private data without a public URL'). High willingness-to-pay; worth its own marketing surface.",
"Plan-gating drives upgrades: free tiers ship a small subset (OptiSigns free = 25 basic apps, no Dashboards/SplitScreen/scheduling; ScreenCloud Core lacks Dashboards/Power BI). The app library doubles as the upgrade funnel.",
"Rise Vision blurs app/template: it pairs '50-750+ auto-updating templates' WITH integrations and an AI presentation generator, so the operator picks a finished, branded, animated board that's already wired to (e.g.) Power BI — not a blank app. Strong 'almost does it for you' model that fits VenueOS's AI-Designer + Concierge direction.",
"Schedule-per-app / dayparting: content (including app instances) can be scheduled to show/expire at set times (OptiSigns scheduling, gated above free). Each app instance should be independently schedulable, not just whole playlists."
]</uxNotes>
<doBetterIdeas>[
"AI-CONCIERGE APP SETUP (nobody does this well): operator pastes their website URL or describes their business in one sentence -> VenueOS's Integration-Discovery service picks the right apps (found Toast -> Menu Board; found an Instagram Business -> Social wall; news for a school) AND pre-fills each config form. Competitors make you hunt the grid and fill forms by hand. This is VenueOS's existing Concierge + Discovery service applied to the app library — a true leapfrog.",
"SECURE SERVER-SIDE DASHBOARD SCREENSHOT service (copy + beat ScreenCloud): render private Power BI/Tableau/Looker/Grafana/intranet in the cloud, credentials in a secrets vault, ship only an encrypted IMAGE to the screen. This (a) shows login-walled data with no public URL, AND (b) sidesteps the Chromium-83 LED limitation entirely (an image always renders where a heavy live SDK won't). Build ONCE, reuse for every dashboard/intranet app. This is the single highest-value net-new build.",
"HONEST SOCIAL by default (trust differentiator): every competitor ships 'Instagram/Facebook/X' apps that quietly broke in 2025 (Basic Display API EOL, oEmbed gutted, X paywalled, Play DROPPED Twitter). VenueOS already grades TOS risk honestly — surface that in the config: tell the operator 'Instagram needs a Business account or a Walls.io wall' up front, auto-offer the aggregator path, and never ship a costume. Honesty + the aggregator-URL fallback = social that actually keeps working.",
"PER-APP STARTER TEMPLATES: when an operator adds an app, drop a designer-grade, brand-applied board pre-wired to it (Rise Vision-style), using VenueOS's AI-Designer. 'Add Google Reviews' -> a finished reviews board, not an empty zone. Leverages the AI-Designer flagship already shipped.",
"ONE generic 'Dashboard' + 'Embed' app behind MANY named tiles: implement the long tail (Domo/Monday/Zendesk/Qlik/Salesforce/Geckoboard) as a single secure-embed app, then expose named logo tiles for marketing. Infinite app count, ~zero marginal code.",
"NAMED-FEED SEED LIST: pre-seed 20+ named news/sports/finance apps that all resolve to RSS_FEED/LIVE_DATA with pinned URLs + branded styling. Matches Yodeck/ScreenCloud app counts for days of work, and the operator picks a logo instead of finding a feed URL — better UX AND bigger number.",
"TikTok-video + Vimeo + Twitch as easy wins OptiSigns lacks: TikTok single-video oEmbed is free + low-risk; Vimeo/Twitch are official iframes. Ship them as named apps to out-list OptiSigns on the video category cheaply.",
"VERTICAL-AWARE app library: filter/sort the grid by the tenant's vertical (Sports tenant sees Scores/Sponsor/Streaming first; Restaurant sees Menu/Reviews/POS; Corporate sees Teams Rooms/Power BI/SharePoint). VenueOS is multi-vertical by design — competitors show one flat grid to everyone.",
"PREVIEW-ON-THE-REAL-CANVAS + Taurus-safe badge: show the live preview at the screen's real resolution AND flag any app that won't render on Chromium-83 LED controllers (heavy SDKs) — auto-route those to the screenshot service. No competitor is LED-aware; VenueOS's player fleet makes this a real differentiator.",
"APP INSTANCE = brandable, schedulable, shareable object: a configured app inherits the BrandKit, can be dayparted independently, and shared across child tenants in the fleet (district->schools, HQ->locations). Combine ScreenCloud's share-across-Spaces with VenueOS's existing fleet/brand hierarchy."
